reason: Batch 003 source audit corrected the wrong Group D storage premise. PD 1096 classifies Group D as Institutional and Group G as Storage and Hazardous; RA 9514 supplies protected-exit and special-hazard rules.

proposed.text: A laboratory contains a Group G high-hazard paint storage room beside a Group B office. What source-backed protection should the architect coordinate?

options.text: No separation because both rooms are in one building
At least four-hour fire resistance, automatic fire protection, or both; high-hazard use requires both

proposed.rationale: RA 9514 special-hazard provisions apply to storage hazards greater than normal occupancy; high-hazard uses require both rated construction and automatic protection.
proposed.explanation: The edit aligns with PD 1096 Group G and RA 9514 Section 10.2.6.10(A).
proposed.code_citation: PD 1096 Rule VII Group G; RA 9514 2019 RIRR Section 10.2.6.10(A)
